file.why: 0xfa is the TEXT lane's request byte and has no meaning here
exactly one byte, or it is not a control

text.why: COMPLETE belongs to the file protocol and has no meaning on a conversation

textFrame.why: the minimum: 5-byte header plus a 16-byte tag
one byte short of a tag; the Web fails the text lane on this rather than routing it

frameClass.label: two bytes starting with ACCEPT
frameClass.why: a longer frame that merely STARTS with a control byte must never be read as consent

frameClass.label: two bytes starting with BATCH_ABORT
frameClass.why: same rule, for the one control that travels sender to receiver

frameClass.label: one byte that is not a control
frameClass.why: below the 5-byte header there is no kind, whatever the first byte looks like

frameClass.label: ack, 12 bytes
frameClass.why: parseAck refuses it, and it must not fall through into the protected stream either

frameClass.label: chunk, header only
frameClass.why: shape routing only; the AEAD then fails it

frameClass.label: legacy done (kind 2)
frameClass.why: routed so the receiver can report an older peer, never parsed

frameClass.label: text frame on the file lane
stored-keys handoff (kind 12)
frameClass.why: unroutable for a client that does not announce preupload/1, which is every native client. A client that DOES announce it demuxes kind 12 by kind alone, ahead of the file receiver, including a frame too short to be a valid one.

authPayload.label: caps and unknown fields are NOT covered
quote and backslash in the sdp
other C0 controls escape as lower-case backslash-u00XX
DEL and C1 are emitted RAW, not escaped
astral characters are emitted raw as UTF-8, never as surrogate escapes

linkLeavePayload.label: the reverse direction is a DIFFERENT string
linkLeavePayload.why: a relay that reflects a leave back at its sender verifies the reversed tuple and fails

linkLeavePayload.label: other C0 controls escape as lower-case backslash-u00XX
DEL and C1 are emitted RAW
U+2028 and U+2029 are emitted RAW by JSON.stringify
astral character, as UTF-8 rather than surrogate escapes
unpaired high surrogate
linkLeavePayload.why: JavaScript escapes a lone surrogate as backslash-udXXX (well-formed JSON.stringify). A Swift String cannot hold one at all, so the Swift port has no defined behaviour here and must skip this row. Reachable only through a hostile signalling relay; hub peer ids are ASCII hex. See relayium-link-v1.md section 12.

shapes.label: auth is 44 characters of nonsense
shapes.why: the SHAPE is right, so one unit of budget is spent and the HMAC runs, and fails

piecePlainBytes.why: capped at CHUNK_SIZE; a bigger allowance buys nothing
the smallest connection this protocol will use

manifestFileCount.why: an empty manifest is not a batch

advanceAck.why: exactly what was emitted is allowed

resumePoint.why: the exact end of a file
